sb_prompt: FIND OUT WHAT THE OTHER CALLER DOES IN THE WAY OF LAWN AND GARDEN WORK.DOES THE OTHER CALL ENJOY DOING IT?  COMPARE THIS TO YOUR OWN SITUATION.
turns: So, what kind of gardening do you do?
I enjoy working on my lawn and garden quite a bit.

What's your favorite vegetable to grow?
I used to grow tomatoes too, but I found that they were too susceptible to disease.

Definitely give it a try, it's worth it.

I grow basil, oregano, and thyme mostly.

Yeah, I've grown strawberries and blueberries in my garden before.

I really like growing blueberries, they're very flavorful and easy to maintain.
I've never tried growing blueberries before, maybe I'll give it a shot next season.
That sounds like a great idea.

Yeah, coffee grounds can definitely help.
I also heard that companion planting can help with pest control.
That's a good point, I should try companion planting next season.
Yeah, companion planting can definitely help with pest control.
What about you, do you have any favorite plants or techniques you like to use in your gardening?
I also enjoy using raised garden beds, it makes it easier for me to maintain the soil and keep it healthy.
That sounds like a good idea.
I also like using natural fertilizers like compost and manure to keep the soil healthy.
Yeah, I've heard that raised garden beds can be really helpful for maintaining the soil.
Yeah, using natural fertilizers is definitely a sustainable way to keep the soil healthy.
That sounds like a great way to maintain the soil.

Yeah, I've had to deal with weeds before.

I use a hoe to keep them under control.
